shortDescription: Create, update or delete truenas cronjobs.

options.name: api_token
options.description: The api token for the truenas server.

options.name: command
options.description: The command the cronjob will run.

options.name: dom
options.description: The day of month in which the cronjob will run.

options.name: dow
options.description: The day of the week to run the cronjob.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the cronjob is enabled or disabled.

options.name: hour
options.description: The hour in which the cronjob will run.

options.name: minute
options.description: The minute in which the cronjob will run.

options.name: month
options.description: The month in which the cronjob will run.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether to create, update (present) or remove (absent) the cronjob.

options.name: stderr
options.description: When unset, any error output is mailed to the user account cron used to run the command.

options.name: stdout
options.description: When unset, any standard output is mailed to the user account cron used to run the command.

options.name: url
options.description: The url of the truenas server.

options.name: user
options.description: The user (username) who will run the cronjob.

options.name: verify
options.description: Whether to verify the ssl certificate or not
